description.p: Crimson is a desktop graphical client powered by yt-dlp and FFmpeg for downloading and converting online media streams for offline archiving.
Built with Python and Qt6 (PySide6), it executes network extraction and stream multiplexing on secondary worker threads to keep the interface responsive during transfers.

ul.li: Download video in the best available quality or limit it to 2160p, 1440p, 1080p, 720p, 480p or 360p, in MP4, MKV or WebM containers
Extract audio into MP3, M4A, WAV or FLAC, in the best available quality or at 320, 192 or 128 kbps
Download a single media link or an entire playlist, or queue up to 50 links with Sequential Archiving
Save directly to a default folder, pause and resume transfers, and get a warning when the disk runs out of space
Customize the interface with nine curated visual themes, including Frutiger Aero and the animated glass themes
Switch instantly between 58 supported languages at runtime

description.p: 13 new languages and a friendlier language menu:

ul.li: New languages: Bulgarian, Croatian, Danish, Estonian, Finnish, Gujarati, Kannada, Latvian, Lithuanian, Malayalam, Punjabi, Serbian and Slovak, for a total of 58
The language menu now shows each language by its native name, sorted like GNOME
The settings window now grows to fit languages with longer texts instead of cutting them off

description.p: New visual themes and clearer error messages:

ul.li: Three new animated glass themes: Star Hunter, Komoki and Time Moves Slow
Download errors now show a short, translated explanation instead of the technical message
Improved compatibility with public videos on some platforms

description.p: New download options, a redesigned settings window and many reliability improvements:

ul.li: Sequential Archiving: queue up to 50 links and download them one after another
Choose the audio and video quality for each download, or set a fixed quality in the settings
Optional playlist downloads and a default download folder
Downloads pause automatically when the disk is full and can be resumed after freeing space
Settings are now organized into System, Advanced and About tabs
20 new languages, for a total of 45
New interface icons and the native system file chooser on Linux
Fixed pausing playlists, very long file names and several other issues

description.p: Complete restructuring of the project into a modular Python package with its own build system:

ul.li: Split the single-file application into separate modules (interface, themes, languages, download engine)
Added a Meson build system that installs the application, desktop entry, metadata and icons
Downloads now run in a temporary folder and the finished file is moved to the location chosen in the save dialog, so no static file system permission is required in sandboxed environments
Fixed the file extension being duplicated in saved file names (for example audio.mp3.mp3)
The transfer speed and remaining time now keep the last known value instead of flickering to Unknown

description.p: Flatpak sandbox compliance, vector iconography, and Linux desktop integration update:

ul.li: Added XDG_DATA_HOME sandbox directory support for persistent configuration storage
Added Flatpak runtime detection to delegate dependency updates to the package manager
Updated application icon with a 512x512 high-resolution PNG and scalable SVG
Registered canonical reverse-DNS desktop entry identifier for Wayland window association

description.p: Complete migration to PySide6 (Qt6) with asynchronous multi-threaded architecture, Frutiger Aero visual identity, and support for 25 languages.
